en.expert: An explicit missing session path no longer falls back to a fresh empty session. The merged change preserves the caller's request for continuity by reporting that the target could not be found.

en.expert: Reusing throwIfMissing closes this fallback path rather than introducing a new recovery identity. It establishes target existence, not universal correctness of restored workspace, model or control state.
en.kitchen: The same missing-book check used by other ways of returning to work now covers this named request. A missing book produces an error; finding it still does not certify the rest of the station.
